user.description: Choose the country of your Albert Heijn account.

login.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
login.description:
You log in on **AH's own page**, with your password and the 6-digit code. Home Assistant never sees your password.

1. Open the developer tools of your browser (**F12**, or **⌥⌘I** on a Mac) and go to the **Console** tab.
2. Open the [AH login page]({login_url}) in that tab and log in.
3. At the end the browser cannot open the `appie://` link and shows it in the console. Copy the whole `appie://login-exit?code=…` link.
4. Paste it below and submit **right away**: the code expires within a few minutes.

AH's verification step sometimes refuses a regular browser. Then try again a bit later or in another browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox).
